title: Buy versus build: how to justify the decision

videos.script: Sooner or later every architect is asked the same question. Should we buy this, or build it? {{question}} At Serra Alta the question has a deadline. Coleta pays nineteen hundred farms on the tenth of every month, and the man who wrote it retires in 2028. {{coleta}} Joana has three options. Buy a dairy product sold as a service. Extend SAP, which the company is moving to S/4HANA anyway. Or build it in house, which is what she did for eight years before she came here. {{options}} The first two quotes on her desk look close. Two million reais to buy, two point one to build. Neither number is what the thing will cost. {{quotes}} This lesson builds the real sheet, three years out, with every line in it. The integration, the people, the upgrades, and the price of leaving. Then it asks what happens when the build runs late, or the price goes up at renewal. {{curves}} It ends with a page the finance director can sign. What was chosen, what the numbers rest on, where the choice is weakest, and what would make you decide again. {{record}}
